---
name: Compatibility report
about: Share results from a dimmable or CCT luminaire
---
Manufacturer/model, fixture type, firmware, number of dimming channels and CCT range:

Tested: discovery, authorization, power, dimming, CCT, individual channels,
external state changes, disconnect/reconnect, lamp power interruption, Homey reboot.

Do not include device/network identifiers or credentials. RGB, groups, scenes,
sensors, switches and network commissioning are outside P0.
